description:
Join a dedicated team at a reputable skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA, as an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON). This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a compassionate and experienced nursing leader ready to make a significant impact on resident care and staff development. We are seeking a professional who thrives in a supportive environment and is committed to long-term engagement.

In this vital leadership role, you will collaborate closely with the Director of Nursing to oversee daily nursing operations, ensure the highest standards of patient care, and maintain regulatory compliance. Your expertise will be crucial in mentoring nursing staff, implementing best practices, and fostering a positive and efficient work environment. This position offers a chance to contribute to a facility dedicated to excellence in resident well-being.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a leadership or supervisory role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and compliance
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Hernando, FL. This PRN opportunity offers flexibility for professionals looking to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, assisting patients in regaining mobility, strength, and function through therapeutic exercises and modalities. This role is crucial in helping individuals achieve their highest level of independence and improve their quality of life.

We offer a competitive hourly rate for this PRN position, providing an excellent opportunity to contribute your skills in a supportive environment. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and patient care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida.
Prior experience working as a PTA, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation environment.
Ability to provide compassionate and effective therapy services to a diverse patient population.
Flexibility to work PRN shifts as needed.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for PTA ranges from $28.00 - $37.00.
